reference_state: 18 December 2015, street-facing upper storey over the shared entrance to Yongjia Road Lanes 19 and 21
later_checks: 8 September 2017 confirms the left leaf of the right opening swung out. On 22 February 2020 the right pair are shut and reveal two tall leaves with three thin intermediate rails and four lights apiece.
photographic_apertures: The local joint camera fits the dark outside boundary at the wall. X extents and four ground-relative heights are approximate; the camera result underlies all widths. The frame/sill setback and paint colour are estimates. No construction drawing or measured section was available.

left_leaf_right_window.interpretation: The panel and all three horizontal divisions are visible. Swung out beyond a right angle. 100–115 degrees is visually consistent given registration uncertainty.

right_leaf_right_window.interpretation: A narrow edge is visible on the streetward right. Its nearly edge-on opening is less certain than that of the left leaf. The later closed pair supplies the count of horizontal divisions.

supporting_views.window_glass_2020: center20-upper, right opening through both leaves; three horizontal rails at approximately 24, 50 and 76 percent of the clear height. The material boundary around each pane is distinct.
supporting_views.canopy: The left opening retains a shallow dark, ribbed sheet projecting over its head in the 2015 and 2020 photographs. Its thickness and projection are estimated.
supporting_views.limits: The appliance or rack between the two windows is a separate assembly. The open right pair frame a dark interior recess, for which only the exterior appearance is modelled.
